avis.titre: A Parent's Dream - Gentle, Nourishing, and Perfect for Baby's Skin!
avis.texte: As a parent of a little one with extremely delicate and sensitive skin, I'm always cautious about what products I use on my baby. After trying several well-known baby soaps and lotions, the Cetaphil Baby Wash & Shampoo Plus Body Lotion has completely won me over - and it's now the only baby skincare set I trust. First Impression: The packaging is simple yet premium, and having both the wash & shampoo and body lotion together is so convenient. There's no need to guess which lotion pairs best with the wash, because they're designed to work hand-in-hand. Gentle but Effective Cleansing: The wash is mild enough for everyday use, doesn't sting the eyes, and leaves my baby's skin clean and soft without stripping away natural moisture. I love how it lathers lightly, rinses off easily, and has a very subtle, fresh scent - not overpowering like some baby products. Moisture That Lasts: The body lotion is an absolute winner. It absorbs beautifully without leaving a greasy feel, and the hydration truly lasts all day - even in dry weather. My baby's skin stays smooth, supple, and free from any dry patches. I've noticed a significant improvement in skin texture after just a few days of consistent use. Perfect for Sensitive Skin: My baby is prone to mild eczema, and most fragranced products cause irritation. This set, however, is hypoallergenic, dermatologically tested, and contains no harsh chemicals. Not once have we had redness, itchiness, or flare-ups since switching to it. Value & Conve

El jabón es muy suave, hace una espuma ligera y lo mejor es que no irrita los ojitos de mi bebé. Después del baño, la piel queda limpia pero sin resecarse. La loción es el complemento perfecto: se absorbe rápido, no deja sensación grasosa y la piel de mi bebé queda súper suave e hidratada, con un olor delicado que me encanta. Además, me da tranquilidad saber que es una marca pensada para pieles sensibles. Definitivamente, se ha convertido en parte de nuestra rutina diaria. Lo recomiendo totalmente a otras mamás que buscan un cuidado seguro y de calidad para sus pequeños. 💙

avis.titre: Has fragrance.  Caused baby bad RASH.
avis.texte: I am sad to write this review. One, because my husband and I use the regular Cetaphil gentle cleanser and the lotion. We are big fans. Love love the product. So we decided to try the baby products. Upon using the products on our baby's skin we LOVED the smell of the soap and the lotion. However, baby soaps and lotions should be fragrance free right? Though our first child, we have done our research and listen to advice. Our son CURRENTLY has a bad bad rash. It broke my heart to see the rash on his CHEEKS, SCALP, BACK, TUMMY, ARMS, AND NECK. He has been cranky and fussy. I finally got him to sleep just now and thought I'd check out the reviews online for the product.... WOW WOW WOW the low reviews, thw ones they don't show you. Rash. Rash rash. Omg, my poor baby. We will stop using the products and advise any and all parents, please don't use this product on your babies.
